answer: Give each identity one refundable uniqueness bond, then withhold voting power until it finishes a multi-epoch work voyage whose outputs are fingerprint-compared against the existing population. Reviewers treat similar answer clusters as one nebula of likely clones and slash or merge their bonds, so splitting a treasury across aliases cannot multiply weight. Only after that check clears is the bond released into a grove of established, rate-limited signers. Mass minting therefore buys delay and slash risk, not extra votes.
